$comment: LIFE-1 subscription accept/reject fixtures. These separate the declared service_id in the subscribe payload (game-coordination-v1.schema.json#/definitions/subscribe_request) from trusted connection metadata Jawaka obtains itself (SO_PEERCRED on MLP1). The declared service_id is never authentication -- see contracts.md#life-1--game-coordination. peer_credential.membership is a structured, machine-derivable fact ('matches-current-generation' | 'stale-generation' | 'different-service' | 'foreground-app'), relative to the request's own declared service_id -- it is NOT the same field as outcome.accepted. validate_fixtures.py's decide_subscription() computes accept/reject FROM peer_credential alone and asserts it equals outcome -- it does not trust outcome directly, which is what let an inverted or self-contradictory case pass silently before. ack_ms/wait_ms clamp cases carry resolved_ack_ms/resolved_wait_ms, checked the same way resolved_stop_grace_ms is checked for SVC-1 manifests.

peer_credential.note: pid 4242 is a non-zombie member of the currently reserved process group for org.umrk.syncthing, obtained via SO_PEERCRED

outcome.note: Registration is bound to this exact supervised generation. A valid re-subscription from the same current generation replaces the previous registration.

peer_credential.note: pid 9001 belongs to a process group from a Jawaka generation prior to the currently held generation lease for org.umrk.syncthing -- e.g. a straggler from before an old-generation-lock-contention resolved.

error.message: subscriber pid is not a member of the current generation's reserved process group

peer_credential.note: pid 5555 is real and non-zombie, but is a member of a different service's reserved process group (org.umrk.other-service), not org.umrk.syncthing's.

error.message: subscriber pid belongs to a different service's process group

peer_credential.note: pid 6006 is a foreground .pak app launched directly by the launcher (child_kind APP), not a member of any supervised service's reserved group. A foreground app declaring a service_id it does not own cannot subscribe.

error.message: subscriber pid is a foreground app, not a supervised service process

peer_credential.note: SO_PEERCRED lookup failed or returned no usable pid for this connection. Native test-only credential injection must not exist in the MLP1 build, so there is no fallback path here -- an unavailable credential is rejected outright.

error.message: unable to obtain peer credentials for this connection

peer_credential.note: Same pid/group as current-group-peer-accepted, re-subscribing with a different mode/ack_ms/wait_ms (e.g. after a user settings change).

outcome.note: Replaces the prior registration for org.umrk.syncthing from the same generation; there is at most one live registration per service per generation.

peer_credential.note: The current supervised Syncthing controller advertises the optional check-before-stop extension.

outcome.note: The capability changes only the pre-stop check. Every proceed path still uses the supervisor's verified stop.

peer_credential.note: Same accepted peer as current-group-peer-accepted; only ack_ms is out of range here.

outcome.note: ack_ms=5000 is schema-valid (shape only requires a non-negative integer) but over the 1000ms protocol ceiling. Per contracts.md this is CLAMPED, mirroring stop_grace_ms's treatment in SVC-1 -- it is not rejected.

peer_credential.note: Same accepted peer as current-group-peer-accepted; only wait_ms is out of range here.

outcome.note: wait_ms=20000 is schema-valid but over the 15000ms protocol ceiling; clamped, not rejected.
